label: Legacy Pre-3.0 configuration (Sync Gateway)
type: Sync Gateway's original, file-based configuration format, retained for backward compatibility behind the disable_persistent_config flag. Does not support scopes/collections at all. Not modifiable via the Admin REST API in a way that persists past a restart, and incompatible with load-balanced multi-instance configuration changes.
note: Sibling of sgw:persistent-configuration (which replaces it) - the round's clearest 'configuration/ mostly reuses access-control/security vocabulary, but its OWN mode axis (legacy vs. persistent vs. bootstrap) is genuinely new' finding.
